sentences.text:
Quash the charge-sheet as well as the impugned summoning order dated 20-02-2019 in respect of the case crime no. 671/2018, under section 498A, 323,504,
506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act at Police Station-P.G.I. District-Lucknow pending in the court of Special C.J.M. (Custom), Dstrict-Lucknow bearing case no.18474 of 2019 (State Vs Anoop Mishra ), as contained in Annexure no. 1 & 2 to this Petition, on the basis of the compromise between the parties , in the interest of justice.

ii. Stay every proceeding against the petitioner which is arising out from the charge-sheet as well as the impugned summoning order dated 20-02-2019 in respect of the case crime no. 671/2018, under section-498A, 323,504 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P.
Act at Police Station-P.G.I., District-Lucknow pending in the court of Special C.J.M.
(Custom), Dstrict-Lucknow bearing case no.18474 of 2019 (State Vs Anoop Mishra),
as contained in Annexure no. 1 & 2 to this Petition, on the basis of the compromise between the parties, in the interest of justice."
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that both the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court and have entered into a compromise.
As such, keeping in view the settlement arrived at between the parties and the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in this regard, the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.

Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the Trial Court as such compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the parties concerned before the Court.

Considering the aforesaid, the instant application is disposed of finally in following terms:-
(i) The parties to the proceedings i.e. Case No. 18474 of 2019 (supra), shall appear before the concerned Court within four weeks from today and file the compromise.
(ii) If the parties appear before the concerned Court in terms of above, the concerned Court shall proceed to verify the compromise between the parties to the proceedings and prepare a report to the same effect and the original compromise deed be made part of record.
(iii) The concerned Court shall conclude the process of verification of compromise within two week's from the date of production of copy of this order.
(iv) The concerned Court shall permit the parties to the proceedings to obtain the certified copy of the report as well as compromise deed.
(v) It shall be open to the applicant to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
